name: deliverd
description: Give any AI agent a way to ask a person — for approval, a decision, an answer or a review.

plugins.name: deliverd
plugins.description: Human-in-the-loop for Claude Code: the Deliverd MCP server, five skills — approval (ask a person before a consequential action), tasks (keep long work on its objective), ethics (put concerns about harm to a person in front of whoever decides), artifact (build and publish an HTML page) and compliance (do AI work under an organisation's governance, with evidence an auditor can check) — and three commands: /deliverd:ask, /deliverd:status and /deliverd:publish. One install.
